objective.name: sandbox.dsl.fail.closed
objective.description: DSL flow that fails on an engine-native error after one successful local wrapper subcall.

#root.role: Run one successful local wrapper step, then fail terminally on a missing reflexive meaning lookup.

effects.local_wrapper_runtime: The local wrapper runtime is invoked.
effects.terminal_error: The terminal response is an execution-visible propagated error.

transformation_contract.morphing: A local DSL request becomes one terminal propagated error after one successful local wrapper step and one failing engine-native step.
invariants: The flow always executes the initial local wrapper step before the failing read.meaning step.
The successful pre-step does not become a terminal success once the later engine-native step fails.
The scenario is intentionally fail-closed and exposes propagated error semantics.
success: This scenario does not define a nominal successful terminal payload in the tested path.
Observable correctness is the propagation of the terminal error rather than a success payload.
failure: The flow fails terminally when the read.meaning step cannot resolve the missing target.
No intermediate wrapper response must leak as an external terminal response once the later step fails.
notes: This scenario exists to validate fail-closed orchestration, not nominal business behavior.
The missing lookup is deliberate and part of the contract.
